ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Class sessions will be held on the following weekends in Champaign: June 21-22; June 28-29; July 12-13; July 19-20. Thursday sessions will meet 9:00am-5:00pm. Friday sessions will meet from 8:00am ? 12:00pm CDT. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.) and waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC. The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois, Board of Trustees.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC or EDD:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC.
